caption: The drawing depicts an architectural scene featuring two red arched columns topped with alternating red and white blocks, with blue and red decorative dots accentuating the arches. In the center, there is a fireplace or hearth with a grayish-black opening, surrounded by a frame adorned with red lines, blue curves, and a small cross at the top. Above the hearth, there is a blue feather or branch-like motif. The background shows a pale cream or beige wall illustrated with faint horizontal lines resembling bricks. To the left of the fireplace, a decorative circular object with a radiating pattern and a red center is mounted above a red, vase-like pedestal. The floor in front of the fireplace is covered by a geometric pattern of alternating salmon-pink and off-white diamond tiles framed by a blue border, which is then surrounded by a larger area of reddish-brown rectangular tiles. On the bottom right corner, the artist’s signature "Frank G. Sanchez" is visible. The color palette for the drawing includes red, blue, gray, blanco, and brown tones.
title: Wall Painting and Baptismal Niche
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
